headline: An intelligence report written with a chatbot nearly sent US forces to board a Chinese ship, according to a CNN investigation now being recirculated.
score_reason: The CNN report dates from 18 Sep 2026, rests on anonymous sources and has not been confirmed by other major outlets; today's NDTV item only recaps it.
importance_line: A single AI error came close to an armed confrontation between the two largest powers, which bears on everyone exposed to a US-China clash and on how militaries vet AI output, but the account comes from one outlet's anonymous sources and is two weeks old.
summary: CNN reported on 18 Sep 2026, citing four sources, that an intelligence report produced by a US Special Operations Command analyst with the help of a chatbot wrongly claimed a Chinese ship in the Middle East carried nuclear weapons components during the Iran conflict earlier this year, and that armed personnel were preparing to board and aircraft were airborne before officials checked the report and called off the operation; NDTV recirculated the account on 3 Oct 2026. One source told CNN the report was "completely wrong" and "almost started a war", while The Guardian notes the story has not been verified by other major outlets.
notes: Score lowered from 6 to 4: stale (CNN 18 Sep 2026) and single-outlet. NDTV blocked; CNN original not fetched directly; facts from Guardian, UNILAD Tech and Bastille Post write-ups crediting CNN.
